title: Tear-off
description: A roll of paper ticket stubs printed with recently played songs, on clean fine stock with crisp ink and perforations that feather slightly as they tear. Twist the end one and it lifts and unzips hole by hole; yank it and it snaps clean. Drag a torn stub to the reader along the bottom and it pulls itself square into the slot, feeds in and plays that song's preview with a rolling clock; drop in another and the first is pushed back out.
intent: One physical mechanic finished to the edge: a perforation that unzips bridge by bridge under your own twist and snaps under a yank, and a reader that takes the stub you tore and plays its song.
